title: Real-model capability discovery engineering check
research_question: Engineering acceptance only: can the existing local orchestrator discover, describe and invoke a tool without a capability catalogue in its initial prompt?
initial_prompt: Discover a capability for the current UTC time and read its documentation. Then execute it. Put the discovered identifier in the top-level id field and the empty object {} in the top-level arguments field. These are sibling fields. The clock needs no input; utc is an output field. Report the returned timestamp.
